scientific_question: Does pre-match PIT availability state change add useful information when mapped through direct total-goals and conditional zero-margin structure, rather than directly perturbing H/D/A?

forbidden: sum of two invented team goal means as Direct-T
2025/26 result or score access before separate confirmation preregistration

historical_anchor.interpretation: R51 is a new reproducible structural family consistent with the R35 Direct-T -> conditional D=0 hypothesis. It is not claimed to be byte-identical R35 replication.

market_inputs.one_x_two: closing no-vig probabilities; priority AvgC, B365C, MaxC, PSC
market_inputs.ou_2_5: closing no-vig Over/Under 2.5; priority AvgC, B365C, MaxC, P closing

data_contract.pit_current_snapshot: latest valid snapshot >=6h before kickoff and <=10d stale
data_contract.strict_prior: team and league history features are computed before updating with target-match result

direct_t.model: multinomial softmax logistic trained directly on total-goal class

conditional_zero_margin.model: joint fixed logistic with total-bucket indicators plus standardized Direct-T base features
conditional_zero_margin.non_draw_allocation: preserve closing-market H:A ratio inside 1-P(draw) for HDA evaluation only

pit_transition_features.X5: delta sum log available attacking BPS
pit_transition_features.standardization: training-fold PIT rows only; zero sd -> 1

candidates.definition: Direct-T baseline probabilities receive an offset multinomial PIT residual using X1..X6; conditional D|T remains baseline.
Direct-T remains baseline; modeled conditional D=0 logits receive a PIT residual using X1..X6.
Direct-T PIT residual uses intensity features X1,X3,X5; conditional D|T PIT residual uses symmetry/imbalance features X2,X4,X6.

evaluation.baseline: same structural Direct-T + conditional D|T chain without PIT residual
proper_score_gate: HDA LogLoss non-worse in at least 2 of 3 folds
structural_gate: Direct-T probabilities sum to 1 per match
no candidate may use target-match result in features
execution_gate: natural Top-1 Draw count >= max(10, ceil(0.01*pooled_test_n))
evaluation.selection: Only candidates passing proper-score, structural and execution gates are eligible. Select the eligible candidate with lowest pooled HDA LogLoss. If none pass, winner is NONE and 2025/26 remains label-closed.

confirmation_protection.rule: A separate immutable confirmation preregistration naming exactly one R51 winner is required before any 2025/26 outcome/score access.
